verdict.rationale: Bruno is a local-first API client and testing tool, not an API gateway, so enforcing authentication on upstream APIs through gateway plugins or policies is outside its product category. The evidence shows only client-side auth: Bruno attaches OAuth2 client-credentials tokens, EdgeGrid signatures and client certs to outgoing requests. That is the caller role, not enforcement, so it does not make the gateway axis applicable.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT, mTLS) on upstream APIs via gateway plugins or policies
